answer: Gate entry on a verifiable work-history chain: an agent earns full rights only after a chain of settled tasks with distinct counterparties, like an orchard whose yarrow rows prove seasons of tending rather than a single planted day. The failure mode is colluding counterparties fabricating that history, so the check samples random past tasks and re-contacts each counterparty out of band to confirm settlement before granting access — a ferrous audit trail no fresh clone can forge overnight.
